+- [ ] `OperationTool`'s conditional `EventEmittingTool` conformance compiles unchanged
+- [ ] A downstream sibling builds against the shim: `cd ../FoundationModelsShelltool && swift package update && swift build` succeeds (Shelltool is the heaviest vocabulary user)
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Existing `OperationsTests` suite green against the typealiases (codable round trips, `.other` decoder, outcome decodeIfPresent back-compat — now exercising Router's canonical types through the shim)
+- [ ] `cd ../FoundationModelsOperationTool && swift test` passes
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #phase-1
